description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Royal Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Royal Warden dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Royal Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Royal Warden enters, it triggers, creating two tapped artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
